raw.title: Borghese Vase
description:
This distinguished Borghese Vase, crafted in Italy during the early 19th century, stands as an exceptional example of Grand Tour artistry. Inspired by the celebrated antique vase now housed in the Louvre, this sculptural piece epitomises the elegance and sophistication sought by aristocratic travellers during the Regency period.
Origin: Italy, probably Rome
Date: Circa 1800
Material: Alabaster
Dimensions: Height: 39 cm (15.4 in); Diameter: 23 cm (9 in)
Condition: Very fine, with a pleasing natural patina and only minor signs of age commensurate with its history.
The Borghese Vase remains one of the most iconic forms reproduced for the Grand Tour market. Collectors of 19th-century works of art prize such pieces for their fidelity to classical design and their tangible link to Italy’s rich artistic heritage. Modeled after ancient originals, this vase mirrors the mythological grandeur revered by connoisseurs and is reminiscent of prominent examples found in museum collections. Its presence is both a statement in Regency taste and a testament to the enduring influence of classical antiquity.
Notable Features:

Exquisite hand-carved decoration in alabaster, showcasing intricate mythological motifs inspired by the antique original.
Graceful lines and harmonious proportions, reflecting the neoclassical ideals that dominated early 19th-century Italian design.
Rare and highly coveted as a Grand Tour souvenir, this Borghese Vase holds significant collecting value due to its quality, scale, and distinguished form.
Perfectly sized for prominent display on a mantelpiece or entry hall plinth, it would serve as a focal point for interior decoration or as an esteemed addition to any collection of Regency-era vases.

The allure of this Borghese Vase goes beyond decorative beauty, offering both historic resonance and a touch of Italian grandeur to any setting. Its authentic Grand Tour provenance, coupled with exceptional craftsmanship, makes it a distinctive and desirable piece for collectors of 19th-century works of art.

raw.title: Vue de Gdsank ( Danzig ) , école Hollandaise , 1672 , monogrammé .
description:
Vue de Danzig ou Gdsansk , huile sur panneau de chêne , dimensions 27,5 cm x 23,5 cm , avec le cadre 47 cm x 43 cm , daté 1672 , monogrammé W.v.N.y F , école hollandaise .
Allemande au 17 è siècle , ville portuaire elle fait partie des villes de la Hanse . Après le dernier congrès de la ligue en 1669 , elle reste unie aux trois villes de Lübeck , Hambourg et Brême , c'est l'une des places les plus importantes pour l'échange des marchandises dans le trafic entre l'Est , le nord et l'ouest de l'Europe .
En 1919 le traité de Versailles en fait une ville libre , elle est rattachée à la Pologne après la guerre et devient Gdsanck .

raw.title: 18th.c. Oak Dresser Base c.1740
description: Early 18th.c. oak dresser base c.1740. Two plank top with a moulded edge. Two drawers with deep raised mouldings to the drawer fronts, decorative pierced brass escutcheons and later brass swan neck handles. Applied moulding to the front and sides above and below the drawers. Raised on turned and block baluster front legs and straight rear stiles. Some obvious old wear, generally very good condition with great character and particularly good original colour and patina. Cleaned and waxed in our worklisting_sources.

raw.title: Collection of Victorian Silver Claret Jugs
description:
DescriptionA stunning collection of silver claret jugs and a water jug.From left to right:A Victorian silver gilt claret jug, Lawson and Co. Glasgow, 1899. Hallmarked on the foot-rim. With scroll, swag and floral chaste decoration; both cartouches empty; no inscriptions; fluted neck and Rococo spout, with C-scroll cast acanthus handle.
Size 33cm high x 12cm wide x 14cm deep.
£2,750An early Victorian silver claret Jug, Marshall and Sons. Edinburgh, 1838. Hallmarked on the neck. With a Neo Classical acanthus body on dome-spreading foot, with applied cast rose and foliate neck, S-scroll acanthus handle with cast flower head finial. Size 35cm x 18cm x 14cm deep.
£2,750A large Victorian silver claret jug, John Muirhead and Son, Glasgow, 1848. Hallmarked on the neck. Of magnum size with chased floral and scroll body, flat chased decoration, Rococo decoration at the neck, with s-scroll acanthus handle and cast foliate finial. The front of the body is engraved with full armorial.
Size 34cm high x 17cm wide x 13cm deep.
NOW SOLD.An early Victorian Neoclassical silver Claret Jug. Sheffield, 1838. Hallmarked on the spout. There is a presentation inscription on the body to Donald MacFarlane Esquire, Callandar – ‘A small tribute of gratitude for his guardianship of the family of the late Peter MacLaren. Middleton, 1842.’ With cast grape and vine neck handle and finial.
Size 32cm high x 17cm wide x 11cm deep.
NOW SOLDA Victorian water jug. Sheffield, 1899. Hallmarked on the neck. With applied foliate pendant swags and foliate border, with wicker-wrapped raffia handle; hinged spout with plain finial.
Size 28cm high x 14cm wide x 9cm deep.
NOW SOLDPeriod 1837-1901: VictorianCategory Kitchenware & Tableware

raw.title: Couchtisch Glas Vintage – Wohnzimmertisch mit geschnitzten Holzgestell
description: Dieser außergewöhnliche Couchtisch Glas Vintage vereint klassische Eleganz mit dekorativer Ausstrahlung und wird zum stilvollen Mittelpunkt jedes Wohnraums. Die großzügige Glasplatte ruht auf zwei kunstvoll gestalteten Holzsockeln und sorgt für eine elegante Kombination aus Transparenz und ornamentaler Gestaltung. Mit seiner Breite von 150 cm bietet der Wohnzimmertisch viel Platz für Bücher, Dekorationen oder stilvolle Accessoires.

raw.title: Antiker Jugendstil Kronleuchter aus Bronze und Alabaster um 1910
description: Dieser antike Jugendstil Kronleuchter ist ein beeindruckendes Original aus der Zeit um 1910 und vereint Handwerkskunst mit hochwertigsten Materialien. Gefertigt aus massiver Bronze und einer edlen Schale aus echtemAlabaster, verkörpert dieser Leuchter die elegante Formsprache des Art Nouveau. Die harmonisch geschwungenen Arme, floralen Verzierungen und fein ausgearbeiteten Details spiegeln die typischen Merkmale des Jugendstils wider und machen diesen antiken Jugendstil Kronleuchter zu einem außergewöhnlichen Blickfang in jedem Raum.
